title: Proteomic Protocol for Tibetan Hulless Barley Under Osmotic Stress
author: Yulin Wang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbusinwe
materials: Peptides were separated with a Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano system with an Acclaim PepMap C18 (3 μm, 100 Å, 75 μm x 50 cm) and emitted into a Thermo Q-Exactive HF tandem mass spectrometer. Solvent A was 0.1% formic acid in water, while solvent B was 0.1% formic acid in 98% acetonitrile. For each injection, 3 mm3 (approximately 3 μg) was loaded and eluted using a 90-minute gradient from 5 to 35% B followed by a 40 min washing gradient. Data were acquired using either data-dependent acquisition (DDA) or data-independent acquisition (DIA).

steps.title: Sample Homogenization
steps.instruction: Weigh a 1-g subsample and homogenize by grinding in liquid nitrogen, then move the powdered samples to 50 cm3 tubes.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 25 cm3 of precooled acetone (-20 °C) containing 10% (v/v) trichloroacetic acid (TCA) and 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) to the sample.

steps.title: Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 20 cm3 chilled acetone (-20 °C).

steps.title: Protein Lysis and Extraction
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and add lysis buffer (4% SDS, 100 mM Tris-HCl, 10 mM DTT, pH 8.0) to the precipitate.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate for 5 min at 60 W (using 5 s sonication followed by 10 s break)

steps.title: Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Estimate the protein concentration using a bicinchoninic acid (BCA) protein assay kit (Beyotime Institute of Biotechnology, China).

steps.title: Protein Buffer Exchange and Filtration
steps.instruction: Mix the protein extract with 200 mm3 UA buffer (8 M urea, 150 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0) and centrifuge at 14,000 g and 20°C for 40 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mm3 of UA to the filter unit and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 40 min
Discard the flow-through from the collection tube

steps.title: Protein Alkylation
steps.instruction: Add 100 mm3 IAM solution (10 mM IAM in UA buffer) to the filter unit and incubate for 30 min.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter units at 14,000 x g for 30 min

steps.title: UA Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 mm3 of UA to the filter unit and centrifuge at 14,000 x g for 40 min.

steps.title: ABC Buffer Wash
steps.instruction: Add 100 mm3 of ABC (0.05 M NH4HCO3 in water) and centrifuge at 14,000 g.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this step twice (each centrifuge step 40 min)

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 40 mm3 ABC with trypsin (Promega, USA) and incubate for 18 h at 37°C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the filter units to new collection tubes

steps.title: Peptide Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter units at 14,000 x g for 10 min and collect the filtration.

steps.title: Peptide Separation by HPLC
steps.instruction: Separate peptides using an LC-20AB HPLC system (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan) with a high-pH reversed-phase (high-pH RP) column (Phenomenon, Torrance, CA) at a flow rate of 0.8 cm3/min.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Buffer A (10 mM ammonium acetate, pH 10.0) and Buffer B (10 mM ammonium acetate and 90% v/v acetonitrile, pH 10.0)
Monitor absorbance at 214 nm and collect fractions every 75 s
Combine approximately 40 collected fractions into 12 pools
Concentrate each fraction via vacuum centrifugation and reconstitute in 40 mm3 of 0.1% v/v formic acid
